articles.title: Zee moves SAT, seeks one-day extension for warrant subscription

articles.summary: India’s gold derivatives market has scaled rapidly, with average daily turnover crossing ₹2.2 lakh crore and physical exchange deliveries reaching 175 tonnes since 2003.

articles.title: Loan write-offs aren’t loan waivers: What happens to bad loans after banks write them off
articles.summary: A loan write-off is an accounting action that removes an NPA from the books without waiving the lender’s claim. A loan waiver, however, forgives the borrower’s liability.

articles.summary: Following a surge in sugar prices to unprecedented levels last week, the market is now experiencing a decline. Government interventions aimed at curbing hoarding and speculation have contributed to this stabilization.

articles.summary: The driver also offers passengers water and coffee.

articles.summary: FedEx will invest $150 million to build a new air cargo hub in Delhi. This facility will significantly increase package processing capacity at the airport. The hub aims to strengthen air cargo connectivity across North and East India.

articles.title: RBI intervenes to support rupee as oil prices, dollar demand rise: Report
articles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India likely intervened in foreign exchange markets. Elevated oil prices and corporate dollar demand pressured the rupee. State-run banks offered dollars, indicating central bank action.

articles.title: Rupee slips to 95.74 against US dollar as crude prices, importer demand weigh

articles.title: Trump’s SpaceX stake: US President invested up to $50,000 in Musk’s company - report
